atoms.a: Body language is essential to our everyday communication.
b: ++Body language helps us see how people truly feel, since it is harder to fake emotions than to tell a lie.
++Through body language, we can communicate with people even when we don’t speak the same language.
++70-90% of all human communication is non-verbal.
We can also use our phone to communicate.
Body language is the most fun way to communicate.
